snippet.title: Aloft - PS5 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Aloft is coming to PlayStation 5! The game's console debut will arrive with its full release, as Aloft leaves Early Access and launches version 1.0 on PC in early 2027. 

Wishlist now: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012205

Join us in the skies
https://x.com/Aloft_Game
https://www.tiktok.com/@aloft_game
https://discord.com/invite/aloft-game
https://www.instagram.com/aloft_game/
https://bsky.app/profile/aloft-game.bsky.social

Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

#Aloft #survivalgame #cozygames
